endings.description: Seven days have passed. You are still alive, and the seal remains unbroken. For now, the house is silent.
Your debt has gone unpaid for three days in a row. The contract is over. Your time in the house ends here.
Your last life is gone. The house keeps its secrets. Your story ends here.
You opened the attic door. The answers lie somewhere beyond the darkness. Your story is not over yet.
